questions.question:
If A means '-' E means '×' D means '÷' G means '+' then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

21 G 14 D 1 A 2 E 8 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 21 G 14 D 1 A 2 E 8 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 E
 D
 G
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 -
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 21 + __**14 ÷ 1**__ - 2 × 8

⇒ 21 + 14 - __**2 × 8**__

⇒ __**21 + 14**__ - 16

⇒ __**35 - 16**__ = 19.

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question:
What will come in place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '÷' are interchanged and '×' and '-' are interchanged?

10 ÷ 2 - 6 × 7 + 1 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

Given equation: 10 ÷ 2 - 6 × 7 + 1 = ?

Now if '+' and '÷' are interchanged and '×' and '-' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 10 + 2 × 6 - 7 ÷ 1 = ?

Using the BODMAS rule:

⇒ 10 + 2 × 6 - __**7 ÷ 1**__

⇒ 10 + __2 × 6__ - 7

⇒ __**10 + 12**__ - 7

⇒ __**22 - 7**__ = 15.

Hence, the correct answer is *'Option 4'.*

questions.question: 22 is related to 198 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 41 is related to 369. To which of the following is 54 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
**Logic:** First number is multiplied by 9 to get the second number.

⇒ 22 (first number) × 9 = 198 (second number)

⇒ 41 (first number) × 9 = 369 (second number)

Similarly,

⇒ 54 (first number) × 9 = **486 (second number)**

**Hence, the correct answer is "486".**

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Bacteria : Decomposition
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The first word is a cause or agent of the process described by the second word.**

**For, **Bacteria : Decomposition

⇒ Bacteria is the agent that causes** Decomposition.**

Similarly, 

**For, **Yeast : Fermentation

Yeast is the agent that causes** Fermentation.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question: 11 is related to 123 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 20 is related to 402. To which of the following is 13 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
Logic: First number is multiplied by itself and 2 is added to the result to get the second number.

⇒ 11 (first number) × 11 = 121 + 2 = 123 (second number)

⇒ 20 (first number) × 20 = 400 + 2 = 402 (second number)

Similarly,

⇒ 13 (first number) × 13 = 169 + 2 = **171 (s****econd number)**

**Hence, the correct answer is "171".**

questions.question: If 13th March 2007 is Tuesday then what will be the day of the week on 14th Sep 2017?
questions.solution:
If 13th March 2007 is Tuesday,

Let's calculate the number of days between 13th March 2007 and 14th September 2017:

From 13th March 2007 to 13th March 2017:

10 years = 10 × 365 days = 3650 days

From 13th March 2017 to 14th September 2017:

185 days (excluding 13th March 2017 and including 14th September 2017)

But there are three leap years between 2007 and 2017 which is 2008, 2012 and 2016.

So, 3 extra odd days are also here.

Total days = 3650 + 185 + 3 = 3838 days

Now, calculate the number of weeks and odd days:

3838 ÷ 7 = 548 weeks + 2 odd days

Adding 2 odd days to Tuesday:

Tuesday + 2 days = Thursday

Therefore, the day of the week on 14th September 2017 is **Thursday**.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

ZY _ Z _ Z _ _ ZZ _ Z
questions.solution:
**Given:** ZY _ Z _ Z _ _ ZZ _ Z

Let's check all the options,

**Option 1)** ZYYZZ → ZY **__Z /__** Z __**Y**__ Z / __**Y Z**__ Z / Z __**Z**__ Z

**Option 2)** ZYZYY → ZY __**Z**__ / Z __**Y**__ Z / __**Z Y**__ Z / Z __**Y**__ Z **⇒ True (it follows a pattern "ZYZ" repetatively)**

**Option 3)** YZYZZ → ZY __**Y**__ / Z __**Z**__ Z / __**Y Z**__ Z / Z __**Z**__ Z

**Option 4)** YYZYZ → ZY __**Y**__ Z __**Y**__ Z __**Z Y**__ ZZ __**Z**__ Z

**Hence, the given answer is "ZYZYY".**

questions.question:
Seven people, V, F, D, S, R, C, and P are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between V and P. Only two people sit to the right of V. D sits third to the left of S. P is an immediate neighbour of D and F. C is an immediate neighbour of S.

Total how many people sit between S and P?
questions.solution:
According to the given information, seven people, V, F, D, S, R, C, and P are sitting in a straight line, facing south

 
• Only two people sit to the right of V which means V is sitting third from the right end of the row.
 
• Only two people sit between V and P which means P will sit to the left of V. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37b35f1018ebe54b7de772c73d80d28222b7772a88bdd9d06d56580b3196f8c5.png] 
 
• P is an immediate neighbour of D and F
 
• D sits third to the left of S.

There will be two cases, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5c2ba501cfa51c18b0789496e3fc9c735de80e961d1b680f0b6b4ea0b0978c.png] 

 
• C is an immediate neighbour of S. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c4d646ac881b5a16f5bb2fc8f5b60df940621fc9b47bf17a20d5af4cf444eae.png] 

In case 1, there is no place for C to sit immediate neighbour of S. And R will sit between V and D.

So, we will go with only case 2. 

The final arrangement is as follows, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b4b267e84a7ed05727bd96275f346b3375854a0d4085fe4633764ac3e672cb1.png] 

**Hence, Three people sit between S and P.**
